name: Shivnymph
look: a baby teal-and-brown dragonfly nymph with big orange eyes, stubby wing buds, six spindly legs and a little kitchen knife for a tail
entry: It hatches near water with a tiny blade already at the end of its tail. It keeps the edge sharp by scraping it on river stones, and flicks it at anything that comes too close.
how: Wild: common by rivers and in plains.
